cloud_integration.wrapper_header: 6px decorative strip only; no title, status text, or close button
cloud_integration.desktop_system_icons: FINDAT Cloud, Applications, and Trash begin in a spaced left-hand column and retain any user-moved positions
cloud_integration.storage_mode: Supabase-only document bytes; browser metadata only; no custom document table
cloud_integration.desktop_document_layout: Horizontal left-to-right rows below system shortcuts; new files use the next free cell; user positions persist exactly and collision protection prevents overlays
cloud_integration.document_preview: Word, Excel and PowerPoint open in an embedded Office web viewer; PDF opens inline through a typed Blob URL; download remains explicit
cloud_integration.mobile_document_access: Single-tap open on touch devices, full-viewport viewer, immediate cached metadata render, 15-second refresh
cloud_integration.metadata_index: findat-v1/index.json with background full Storage reconciliation
cloud_integration.wallpaper_sync: Supabase Storage findat-v1/settings/personalization.json with a versioned custom-wallpaper.jpg; startup, visibility and 15-second refresh

roles.client: write/edit own article text, upload a cover photo and submit; no assignment, supporting-document changes, delete, approval or publish
roles.consultant: edit/proofread collaborative or assigned articles and change cover photos/supporting media; no general publish privilege, with article-specific publishing only when explicitly delegated by an Administrator
roles.admin: write and publish directly; review/edit/return/delete/approve submissions; delete published articles; protected account management

collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.collaborator_picker: always-clickable button and active-user profile modal; names without role labels; all active Client, Consultant and Administrator profiles
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.contributor_byline_layout: draggable locked face-and-name cards with per-card sizing
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.profile_photos: user-uploaded Supabase Storage avatar with initials fallback
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.request_reliability: durable Postgres requests with incoming/outgoing response history, manual refresh, Realtime updates and 10-second polling fallback
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.accepted_collaborator_invitations: accepted collaborators may add people but only the author or Administrator may remove existing collaborators
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.notification_bell: Font Awesome bell icon with unread count from Supabase Postgres notifications
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.notification_history: read tracking plus clear-history control; unanswered requests are preserved
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.article_visibility: pending collaboration invitations do not expose article content; access begins after acceptance
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.collaborator_selection_count: live 0–5 counter in the picker and saved counter on the editor
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.profile_picture_reliability: Supabase Storage upload with authenticated path policies and Postgres image fallback
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.legacy_collaborator_shortcut: converted into pending requests; automatic article exposure removed
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.existing_request_backfill: older pending, accepted and rejected collaboration rows are added to notification history
collaboration_and_delegated_publishing.ambiguous_article_id_fix: collaborator RPC returns the table row type and uses the primary-key constraint explicitly

python_chart_studio.execution: client-side browser worker; no Python code sent to FINDAT servers
python_chart_studio.article_output: generated PNG chart inserted into article content

courses_profiles_and_article_activity.published_contributor_layout: automatic horizontal wrapping with photos, names and first three qualifications
